task: Build the 5 pending items from PRD §8 (Label state machine, Module 3 workflow skeleton with TRIAGE_MODE switch, composite action interface spec, CLAUDE.md architecture map, hybrid confidence threshold scaffolding) plus the minimal repo scaffolding they depend on. Scope is .github/ infrastructure + docs; no Python/Rust source code is generated since this is a pipeline-scaffold repo.

context.prudentialScope: The PRD describes a 10-module pipeline. This Ralph session delivers only PRD §8 pending items (1-5) plus the minimal scaffolding they require to be coherent. Full workflow implementations for modules 4-10 are intentionally out of scope — those depend on having real source code in py/ and rust/ directories and on finalized agent actions.

stories.title: Repo scaffolding foundation
stories.description: Create the directory structure and shared infrastructure that all other stories depend on: README, docs/ layout, .github/ layout, CODEOWNERS, dependabot, baseline security workflow, Issue Forms (PRD §2 module 1).
acceptanceCriteria: README.md exists and explains the project in <=200 words with a link to the PRD pipeline table
docs/ directory exists with placeholder for architecture.md, security.md
.github/CODEOWNERS exists and assigns review ownership
.github/dependabot.yml exists and watches github-actions ecosystem
.github/workflows/codeql.yml exists and runs CodeQL on push to main
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml and feature.yml exist as structured Issue Forms (YAML valid)
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml disables blank issues

stories.title: Label state machine full definition (PRD §8 item 1)
stories.description: Author the complete Label state machine: every label used anywhere in the pipeline, its category, allowed values, who can apply/remove it, legal transitions, and the triggering workflow. This is the protocol layer every downstream module depends on.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/labels.md exists and documents every label with: name, category (stage/triage/size/type/force), description, allowed transitions, who-can-apply (anyone/triage/maintainer), who-can-remove
Label categories match PRD §3 + §7: stage:*, triage:*, type:*, size:*, force-manual, plus stage:failed from §6

docs/labels.md contains a Mermaid state diagram covering the canonical Issue lifecycle: opened -> triage -> triage-done -> accepted|rejected|needs-info -> (optional design-approved) -> in-development -> verifying -> testing -> ready-for-pr -> in-review -> merged|stage:failed
Every label referenced in any other story's workflows is present in docs/labels.md (verified at the end of US-001 verification by grepping the workflows dir)
.github/labels.yml exists as machine-readable declaration matching docs/labels.md (used for label-sync tooling)

stories.title: Module 3 workflow skeleton with TRIAGE_MODE switch (PRD §8 item 2)
stories.description: Build the咽喉 (chokepoint) workflow that consumes triage-done Issues and produces accepted/rejected/needs-info. Must implement all three modes (auto/manual/hybrid) per PRD §3, gated by repo variable TRIAGE_MODE with per-issue override via force-manual label. This is the most security-sensitive module — must satisfy S1 (read-only + issues:write, no contents:write).
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/judge.yml exists and triggers on issues (labeled: triage-done) and workflow_dispatch
Job permissions are explicitly scoped: contents: read, issues: write, NO contents: write (satisfies PRD S1)
Workflow reads TRIAGE_MODE from repo variable (vars.TRIAGE_MODE) with documented default of 'hybrid'
force-manual label on the issue overrides any TRIAGE_MODE setting to 'manual' (verified by reading the conditional)
auto branch: calls judge action, applies resulting label directly
manual branch: calls judge action, posts suggestion comment ONLY, does NOT apply any accepted/rejected/needs-info label
hybrid branch: calls judge action with output_schema including confidence; if confidence >= threshold apply directly, else fall through to manual behavior
Confidence threshold reads from vars.HYBRID_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD with default 0.7
Every mode writes an audit comment with the reason (PRD §3 'Audit' invariant)
Failure path applies stage:failed label and a comment with the error (PRD §6 失败降级)
Concurrency group prevents duplicate runs on the same issue (concurrency: issue-${{ github.event.issue.number }})

stories.title: Composite action interface specification for all modules (PRD §8 item 3)
stories.description: Define the interface contract (inputs/outputs/secrets/runtime requirements) for each module's composite action, and implement skeleton action.yml files that conform to it. The spec must enable swapping the engine (Claude vs Codex) without breaking callers (PRD §4 'composite action 封装使切换成本为一次配置改动').
acceptanceCriteria: docs/composite-action-spec.md exists and documents, for each module (2,3,3.5,4,5,6,7,8): name, description, inputs (name+type+required+default), outputs (name+type+description), secrets consumed, permissions required, runtime requirements (runner, caches), idempotency contract, failure semantics
Spec defines a COMMON interface all module actions share (issue-number input, repo-token input, dry-run input, stage-output output, audit-comment-output output) so they compose uniformly
.github/actions/<module>/action.yml exists for each of triage, judge, design-review, develop, self-verify, test, pr-open with the inputs/outputs declared in the spec

Each action.yml uses official engine action as the implementation (claude-code-action or codex-action) wired through a switchable engine variable, so swapping engine is one variable change (PRD §4 'engine evolution' decision)
Each action.yml documents its required permissions in a comment block at the top
Each action.yml accepts a context-budget input (max-turns / max-tokens) per PRD §5 '运行上限'

stories.title: CLAUDE.md architecture map spec (PRD §8 item 4)
stories.description: Author CLAUDE.md as the AI agent's first-read map: what the repo is, how it's laid out, where things live, the Label state machine summary, security red lines, and context-budget rules. Per PRD §5 '禁止全仓读入, prompt 限定关联目录, CLAUDE.md 提供架构地图'.
acceptanceCriteria: CLAUDE.md exists at repo root

CLAUDE.md contains sections: Project Overview, Repository Layout (per-directory purpose), Module Map (PRD §2 table condensed), Label State Machine (link to docs/labels.md + 5-line summary), Security Red Lines (S1-S5 verbatim from PRD §7), Context Budget Rules, Engine Configuration (model IDs, fallback), References (links to PRD, docs/*.md)
Repository Layout section enumerates: .github/workflows/, .github/actions/, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, docs/, and references (but does not invent) py/ and rust/ as future homes per PRD §5
CLAUDE.md cross-links to docs/labels.md, docs/composite-action-spec.md, docs/triage-modes.md, docs/security.md
CLAUDE.md context-budget section gives concrete rules: 'do not read entire py/ or rust/; read only directories explicitly named in the Issue/PR; respect --max-turns'
Total length <= 250 lines (architecture map, not a manual)

stories.title: Hybrid mode confidence threshold scaffolding (PRD §8 item 5)
stories.description: PRD §8 item 5 says threshold is '待试运行标定' (pending operational calibration). We cannot ship a calibrated number, but we CAN ship: (a) the configuration slot wired through judge.yml + judge/action.yml, (b) the calibration procedure documented, (c) a starting default of 0.7 with rationale, (d) the audit fields needed to recalibrate from production data.
acceptanceCriteria: vars.HYBRID_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD is the canonical source of truth, referenced by judge.yml and judge/action.yml
Default value when variable unset: 0.7, documented in docs/triage-modes.md and CLAUDE.md

docs/triage-modes.md exists and documents: meaning of each mode (auto/manual/hybrid), the threshold semantics (>= auto-apply, < fall-through to manual), how to change modes, how to override per-issue (force-manual), and the calibration procedure

Calibration procedure section in docs/triage-modes.md specifies: collect N>=50 judged issues, compute precision/recall of auto-apply decisions using maintainer re-review as ground truth, sweep threshold over [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9], pick threshold maximizing F1 subject to precision >= 0.85
judge/action.yml output schema includes the confidence value AND the reason so audit comments can be mined for recalibration
An audit comment template is included in docs/triage-modes.md so every judged issue carries the same fields (decision, mode, confidence, threshold, reason)
